ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels centrally, bounded by low-intensity black pixels at the trailing edge and scattered internal focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous surface centrally. Black pigmentation forms a jagged border along the entire trailing edge and tips. Several distinct circular black spots are mapped: a cluster of four near the median notch, one on the mid-left lobe, and one prominent spot on the distal right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical bounding-box depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude along the full length of the trailing edge. A major, deep irregular indentation is present on the distal third of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, tapering into jagged, upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least six circular high-contrast dark pixel clusters on the white surface, most notably a distinct spot on the distal right lobe and a cluster of four near the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of parallel horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the far lateral margin of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue indentation or amputation on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe, distinct from normal serration.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific spatial configuration of circular black spots across the white ventral field forms a highly unique fingerprint.
